profile.headline: Vice President - Lead Software Developer at JPMorganChase

positions.title: Senior Full stack developer
positions.description:
* Led the development of a comprehensive documentation strategy for all software releases, ensuring clear and concise documentation is available for future reference and troubleshooting.
* Implemented performance optimization techniques to improve the data fetching performance by 50%, resulting in faster and more efficient data retrieval for the application.
* Implementing performance monitoring tools to track and analyze system performance in real-time
* Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices.
* Offered production support by troubleshooting issues and making strategic decisions on immediate fixes or rollbacks
* Directed the full project lifecycle, from conceptualization to deployment, for transitioning a monolithic application to a microservices architecture
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers to enhance their coding skills and promote personal growth
* Converted SOAP to RESTful for improved scalability and ease of integration.
* Worked with .NET-based GUI to integrate new endpoints, resulting in improved user experience.
* Provided mentorship and guidance to three junior team members to foster their professional development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Implemented Concurrency control via Hazelcast, increasing concurrent processing requests by 30%
* Led development of E2E Testing Application, reducing testing time by 40%
* Achieved a significant improvement in API performance by reducing the processing time for 25k payments Senior Full Stack Developer Morgan Stanley by over 87%, from 34 minutes to 45 seconds
* Developed a comprehensive full-stack application for Internal Payment and Position Flow within Goldman Sachs, comprising 10+ microservices integrated via facade layers. Created Poller Service Layer for live notifications
* Wrote Python Scripts for dynamic data testing, improving test coverage by 60%
* Work closely with the product team to determine and prioritize user stories for development, aligning with customer requirements
* Analyze existing systems and identify areas for improvement
* Collaborated with stakeholders to comprehend business requirements and deliver timely, integrated solutions
positions.insights: IntelliJ IDEA, Problem Solving and +5 skills
